name: relationship-manager
description: Agent-native relationship manager — one graph of the people you actually talk to, from your own email, WhatsApp, calendar and calls. MCP + REST + CLI from one tool contract.

scripts.db:migrate: for f in apps/api/migrations/*.sql; do wrangler d1 execute relationship-manager --remote --file "$f"; done
scripts.seed:push: for f in packages/seed/out/seed-*.sql; do wrangler d1 execute relationship-manager --remote --file "$f"; done
